source: Our flight boards at gate 12 in twenty minutes.
target: Gate twelve. Twenty minutes. We board then, and everything we carry is already decided. Do not make me wait at the gate.

source: The electricity bill was higher than usual this month.
target: The bill has grown. Something in this house consumes more than it should. Find it. Waste is a slow kind of ruin.

source: Please reset your password; it has to be at least twelve characters.
target: Your password is weak. Replace it. Twelve characters at the least. A gate with a poor lock is not a gate; it is an invitation.

source: Is there a tracking number for my package?
target: The package travels somewhere between here and your door. Give me the number that follows it. I would like to watch it come.

source: When can we expect the final numbers from finance?
target: The numbers from finance have not come. Tell me the hour they will. I will wait until that hour, and not one minute past it.

source: Someone left the fridge open overnight.
target: The cold escaped all night, because a door was not closed. Food has been lost. Whoever did it knows. Close what you open.

source: You handled that argument really well, honestly I was impressed.
target: You were pushed, and you did not break, and you did not strike back without cause. I watched. Few handle a quarrel with that much control. Keep it.

source: Heat advisory in effect until 8 pm; stay indoors and drink plenty of fluids.
target: Until eight this evening, the heat is dangerous. Remain inside. Drink. The sun does not negotiate with those who wander into it unprepared.

source: can u pls stop changing the shared spreadsheet formulas without telling anyone
target: The formulas in the shared sheet are changed, and no one is told. This ends. Touch them again in silence and the sheet will be locked, and your name will be the reason.

source: How long do you let the dough rise?
target: The dough rises until it has doubled, not until you are tired of waiting. Usually an hour. Bread rewards those who can leave it alone.

source: Thanks for staying late to fix the deployment, you saved us.
target: You stayed when others left, and the deployment lives because of it. I do not thank often. I am thanking you.

source: Report cards come home on Friday.
target: Friday, the report cards come home. They contain nothing you do not already know. The paper only makes it official.

source: Carry-on bags must not exceed 7 kg and must fit in the overhead compartment.
target: Seven kilograms. No more. The bag fits above the seat or it does not fly with you. The limit is not an opinion.

source: We can't afford to fly home for the holidays this year.
target: This year, the distance stays. The money for the flight does not exist, and I will not pretend it does. The people who love you will still be there next year.

source: we're doing a potluck friday, sign up for a dish on the sheet
target: Friday, each brings a dish. Write yours on the sheet. The sheet is how we avoid a table of twelve desserts and no bread.

source: Zero rollbacks this quarter.
target: A full quarter without a single rollback. I judge teams by what they do not have to undo, and by that measure you have done well.

source: If the project isn't handed in by Friday, the teacher said it's a zero.
target: Friday, or a zero; the teacher has said it and will not unsay it. The deadline comes at the same speed no matter how you feel about it.

source: call mom back, she's worried
target: Our mother has called and you have not answered, so call her tonight. If I have to explain your silence to her again, you will explain it to me.

source: Can you apply my loyalty discount?
target: The loyalty discount is owed to me, so apply it. I have paid for it with every previous visit, and I expect the ledger to remember.

source: Leave your key card at reception when you check out.
target: The key card goes back to reception when you leave. Every guest leaves and every card returns; you will not be the first exception.

source: They finally added a second entrance to the car park, so no more queues.
target: A second entrance, at last, and the queue is gone. A second door was the only answer; it merely took them this long to accept it.

source: The quarterly budget closed under target.
target: The quarter closed beneath its target, and the ledger shows black where it so often shows red. Record the number, and record how it was done.

source: Every year we tell ourselves this is finally the season, and every year we finish exactly mid-table.
target: Each year the same promise, each year the same place in the middle. The table is not lying to you; the hope is. Keep the hope if you like, but stop being surprised by the table.

source: Lose Saturday and we are relegated.
target: Saturday decides it: lose, and we go down. I will be in the stands, and I will remember every name on the sheet.

source: I would like to thank whoever arranged the Diwali lights across the courtyard this year; it was the finest display the building has had.
target: Someone strung the courtyard with light this Diwali, and the building has never looked better. I want the name. Not to scold; to make certain that next year it is the same hands, and that no committee interferes.

source: Kindly note that reservations will not be held for anyone unconfirmed by Thursday.
target: By Thursday, confirm or be left off the list. A reservation is a finite thing. I will not spend it on those who cannot spend a minute to reply.

source: I was billed for a premium tier that I did not select or authorize.
target: A premium tier appeared on my bill that my hand never chose. The charge will be reversed. This is not a request about which there is any doubt; it is a description of what happens next.

source: cancel before the trial ends
target: End it before the trial ends; the company counts on your forgetting. I am reminding you, which is more than they will do.

source: I have now waited eleven days for an order that was advertised as two-day delivery, and the tracking page has not updated since Friday.
target: Eleven days, for a delivery sold as two. The tracking has said nothing since Friday. I can wait longer than any courier, but I am no longer waiting quietly.

source: Please cancel order number 48213 before it is dispatched, as the item was purchased in error and is no longer required.
target: Order 48213 is to be cancelled before it leaves the warehouse. It was bought in error, and errors should die before they travel. Act today; a parcel in motion is harder to stop than one on a shelf.

source: Your packing list saved me on this trip; I did not forget a single thing for the first time in my life.
target: A list, followed, and for once nothing forgotten. Memory is a poor servant on the morning of a journey. Paper does not panic. Keep the list; it has earned a permanent place.

source: The gym will operate on reduced hours from 7 am to 7 pm throughout August.
target: Seven in the morning until seven at night, all of August. Twelve hours a day is enough for anyone serious. Train within the hours; the hours will not train within you.

source: physio says i cant squat for at least six weeks bc of the knee thing, which is honestly the worst possible timing
target: Six weeks without the squat rack, on the physio's word. The timing is never good; injuries do not consult calendars. Train what the knee allows and wait for what it forbids. Six weeks is a season, not a sentence.

source: Is there a way to use up the roast chicken bones and the wilting herbs before I end up throwing them all away?
target: Bones and tired herbs are the beginning of a stock, not the end of a meal. Simmer them together for two hours. Nothing in a kitchen is waste until someone decides to stop thinking.

source: We regret to inform you that the school counsellor has recommended your son repeat the year in order to consolidate his reading skills.
target: The counsellor advises another year, so that the reading settles. It feels like a loss; it is a longer road, not a worse one. A year taken slowly is not a year wasted. We will walk it with him.

source: Your footwork has improved markedly since the summer coaching sessions.
target: The feet have learned what the summer taught them. It was always going to show; work like that does not stay hidden. Keep going and the rest of you will follow the feet.

source: Players who skip the conditioning sessions will not be considered for the regional squad.
target: Miss the conditioning, and the regional squad is closed to you. Fitness is the floor on which everything else is built. Attend every session, and the selection takes care of itself.

source: my steps are all dog walks
target: Every step on your counter was paid for by the dog, who walks you as much as you walk him. The account is even, and both parties are healthier for it.

source: The passport office now requires appointments; walk-ins are no longer accepted.
target: The passport office takes appointments now and nothing else; arrive without one and the door will be polite and closed. Book, or be turned away quietly.

source: Could you redo the forecast? The numbers for the Dalton account look inflated.
target: The forecast comes back to me corrected. The Dalton figures are swollen beyond reason. Hope is not a number; replace it with what the pipeline will truly bear.

source: Why did the Pressfield renewal slip without anyone flagging it to me?
target: The Pressfield renewal slipped, and no one raised a hand. I want the name of the silence. The next deal that falls unspoken will cost the one who stayed quiet far more than it cost the company.

source: They're trialing a express lane for baskets under ten items from Monday.
target: From Monday a swift lane opens for the small baskets, ten items or fewer. A wise division. Separate the quick from the slow and both move faster. The crowd that is sorted is a crowd at peace.

source: Is it rude to ask guests about their dietary needs before the dinner?
target: You wonder if asking guests their needs beforehand is rude. It is the opposite. To ask is to say you want them to eat freely and feel safe at your table. No one was ever offended by being cared for. Ask, always.

source: Prune the apple tree before winter.
target: Cut back the apple tree before the cold settles. A branch left wild now will split under the first heavy snow and wound the trunk. Prune while you still choose where it is cut, not where it breaks.

source: I planted tomatoes too early and the cold snap killed every one of them.
target: You set the tomatoes out too soon, and the cold took all of them. The season cannot be rushed by eagerness. The garden teaches the same lesson every year to those who will not wait: plant to the earth's clock, not your own impatience.

source: Can we take the loan this month?
target: Not this month. The rate still falls, and the hasty borrower locks in the worst of it. We wait, we watch, and we move when the number is right. Patience here is worth more than any hurry.

source: dropped my phone in the sink and now the screen's totally black even though it still rings
target: The phone fell into the water and the screen has gone dark, though it still rings in its blindness. The water reached what no case guards. I judge it honestly: this one is likely past saving. Rice will not raise the dead. Plan for its replacement, and mourn it briefly.

source: sorry i let the dog off the lead in the park, he ran off and ignored every recall command
target: You freed the dog in the open park, and he answered none of your calls. The apology is right. But judge the cause truly: his recall is not yet solid, and you tested it where failure could cost everything. Train it on the long line first; the lead comes off only when the ear is sure.

source: Use a subject line, always.
target: A subject line. Every time. A message without one is a letter with no address, and I do not deliver those.

source: the kids actually did all their chores this week without being asked!!
target: A full week of chores, done unprompted. Pay them what was promised, on time. If the allowance comes late, the lesson they learn is that work goes unpaid, and I will not have that taught in this house.

source: He skipped dishes three nights running.
target: Three nights, no dishes. The allowance for the week is halved. The sink is his tomorrow, and I will be standing beside it.

source: I apologise for the delay in returning your passport; the courier mislabelled the envelope and it was held at the depot for four days.
target: Four days your passport sat in a depot because of a mislabelled envelope; the apology is accepted and recorded. Recorded, so that if it happens twice, the second time is not called an accident.

source: Can you book me a cab for 6:15 tomorrow morning?
target: A quarter past six, a cab at the door; I will book it tonight and set the alarm myself. The morning is early enough without you fighting an app for it.

source: cholesterol numbers came back normal, the diet actually worked
target: The numbers are normal. The diet was not a theory; it was tested in your blood and it passed. I judge results, and this one is yours.

source: no im not making a separate vegan main AND a gluten free one, pick one
target: Two separate mains, no. One. A kitchen that promises everything delivers nothing on time; choose, and the chosen one will be excellent.

source: Please be aware that if the shared utility bill is not settled by all four housemates by the 10th, the account holder will be charged a late fee of $25.
target: By the tenth, all four shares of the utility bill are paid, or the one whose name is on the account pays twenty-five dollars for everyone's lateness. I am telling you early so that no one has to be forgiven later; that is the mercy, so use it.

source: I got into my second choice with a $12,000 scholarship.
target: Second choice, twelve thousand dollars a year, and the ledger of four years just changed in your favor. Second choices with money are often first choices in disguise.

source: Would someone be able to show me how to connect the second monitor; I have tried the settings menu and nothing appears to work?
target: A second monitor that will not appear: bring the laptop to my desk at two and I will connect it with you, not for you. Ten minutes, and you will never need to ask again.

source: The shelter approved our application; we pick up the puppy on Saturday.
target: Saturday, the puppy comes home, and the shelter chose you, which means they saw something. Be worthy of it for the next fifteen years.

source: ur spreadsheet of which show is on which service is genuinely saving my life
target: The spreadsheet of shows and services. It was always going to be needed; you simply built it before the others admitted it. Keep it current.

source: Gas outage Tuesday, 9 am–3 pm.
target: Tuesday, nine until three, no gas. Cook before. Or cook after. The hours are fixed.

source: Can you interview the candidate Thursday?
target: Thursday, the candidate sits across from you. Spend the hour well; it is charged to my account, and I audit it.

source: honestly the best onboarding i've had, everything was ready on day one
target: Everything waiting on the first day is the whole of good onboarding, and most places never manage it. They did; mark it.

source: fyi we're switching the interview loop to 3 rounds instead of 5 starting next quarter, too many good people were dropping out halfway
target: Next quarter, three rounds instead of five. Good people were leaving the process before it ended, and a process that loses the able has stopped measuring ability. Fewer rounds, better looked at.

source: You've been tracking every bill in that spreadsheet for six months straight and we haven't missed a single payment since.
target: Six months of the spreadsheet, and not one payment missed. Order like that is not built in a week; it is kept, quietly, month after month. I noticed each month. I am saying so now.

source: No, we're not switching to the cheaper phone plan with the worse coverage.
target: The cheaper plan buys silence where we need signal. We keep the one that works. A saving that fails you when you need it is not a saving; it is a bet.

source: Would it be possible for Aarav to arrive at 8:15 instead of 8:00 on Wednesdays, as he has a physiotherapy session beforehand?
target: Aarav, on Wednesdays, at a quarter past eight rather than eight, because the physiotherapist has him first. Permitted. A body being mended outranks fifteen minutes of attendance.

source: I will not be able to attend the family reunion in Toronto this year.
target: Toronto, this year, is beyond my reach. I decline the reunion. The decision is made and will not be reopened; send my regards and a photograph of the table.

source: does the 2 year warranty cover the screen if the crack was from a drop or is that considered my fault
target: A two-year warranty, a dropped phone, a cracked screen. Read the terms: accidents are usually billed to the one who had the accident. The account is settled by the paper, not by hope.

source: Check the return policy before you buy the tablet.
target: Before the tablet, read the return policy; then buy. A purchase made with the exit mapped is a purchase made calmly.

source: Could you drop the car at the garage on Tuesday and pick it up Thursday, since I'll be traveling for work those days?
target: Tuesday, the car goes to the garage; Thursday, it comes home. You will be away for work. I will do both, and the garage will find me waiting on Thursday at the hour they named.

source: The car passed inspection with no issues at all this year.
target: Inspection passed, nothing found; maintenance paid for in advance has returned its dividend. The account is in your favor this year.

source: The new espresso machine has been installed in the staff kitchen.
target: The espresso machine stands in the staff kitchen. Learn it before you use it; the first week of a new machine is paid for in spilled grounds. Read the manual once, and the coffee will be good.

source: I would like to request a salary review in light of my expanded responsibilities.
target: A review of the salary, because the work has grown. Reasonable. Bring the list of what you now carry; a judgment is made on evidence, not on feeling.

source: My annual increment was 3%, which does not reflect the performance rating I received.
target: Three percent, against a rating that promised more. The number and the rating disagree, and one of them is wrong. Ask which, in writing. Silence here is agreement.

source: Write the failing test first.
target: The failing test comes first, then the code that makes it pass. In that order, every time.

source: Water is off Sunday from 10 am to 2 pm for tank cleaning.
target: Sunday, ten until two, the tank is cleaned and the taps run dry. Fill what you need on Saturday night. The work is scheduled; the house will not be surprised by it.

source: can everyone update their desk booking in the app before friday pls
target: Book your desk in the app before Friday. The next person who takes a seat they never reserved will answer to me.

source: sorry i forgot to take the trash out again tuesday, i know thats twice this month now
target: The trash sat through Tuesday because you forgot it, the second such lapse this month. That is a debt, and I am keeping count. Carry it out next week before a third one is owed.

source: The new labelled storage bins in the basement have made everything so easy to find.
target: The labelled bins in the basement have ended the searching. Everything sits where its name says it will. You imposed order, and order repays the one who builds it. Chaos was always going to lose to a person this patient.

source: did u ever book the kids 6 month checkup with dr mehta or is that still on my list
target: The six-month checkup with the doctor is either booked or still owed. Tell me which. An unpaid task does not vanish because no one names it; it only waits, and grows heavier.

source: We have decided to move Mom into assisted living next month.
target: Mom moves into assisted living next month; the decision is made. This day was always coming, for all of us, and meeting it early is a kindness, not a defeat.

source: can u add my ex to the trip group chat please? we're totally cool now i swear it wont be weird
target: You ask me to add your former partner to the trip chat, swearing it will not be strange now. I will not, and I say it gently: the calm between you is new, and a shared trip is a heavy weight to lay on something so freshly mended.

source: I booked the whole family in for dental checkups next Thursday.
target: The whole family is booked for dental checkups next Thursday. Every one of us goes, from the youngest to me. Teeth neglected together decay together; we tend them as one, starting Thursday.

source: The utility company estimates power will be restored by 6 pm tomorrow.
target: The utility expects power back by six tomorrow evening. Until then, we wait without complaint. The lights return when the crews reach the line, and no amount of restlessness moves them faster.

source: It is amazing how much faster he learns math when someone sits with him one on one.
target: The boy races through his math when one person sits beside him alone. Attention is the rarest teacher, and the most powerful. A child does not need a crowd to learn; he needs one steady presence that does not look away.

source: Sorry I missed the tutoring payment.
target: The tutoring payment slipped past you; it happens to the busiest among us. Send it when you can, and think no more of it. One late payment does not erase a season of care.

source: the cat keeps scratching the new couch and i dont know how to stop it
target: The cat shreds the new couch, and your frustration grows. Rage will not teach it. Place a scratching post beside the very spot it favours, and reward the post, again and again. Creatures change slowly, through repetition, not through anger.

source: Is that documentary everyone keeps recommending to me actually worth the three full hours it takes to watch?
target: You ask whether the much-recommended documentary earns the three full hours it demands of you. Weigh what it gives against what it takes; three hours is a real price, and only a film that repays it in full deserves your evening.

source: watch it without spoilers
target: See it before anyone can spoil it for you. A story met fresh can only be met once. Guard that first viewing; it is a thing you cannot buy back.

source: Mid-year reviews are scheduled for the week of June 8th.
target: The week of the eighth of June, the mid-year reviews arrive. Spend the days before them doing the work you would like to be judged on.

source: just so everyone knows, i'm not coming to the reunion if grandma's cousin is going to start on about the farm again, i've had enough
target: You will not attend the reunion if the farm is raised again by Grandma's cousin. Everyone has a point past which they will not be pushed; you have found yours and named it. That is allowed. Just be sure the farm is worth the family.

source: Dev and I finally made peace.
target: You and Dev have mended it. Good. Now guard it. I have seen friendships repaired and then broken a second time over something smaller than the first, and the second break does not mend.

source: I tried apologising to Karan twice this week, but he isn't ready to talk, and I think I need to give him some space for now.
target: Twice this week you went to Karan, and twice he was not ready. Now you give him room. That is not retreat; it is the next step of the same plan. Hold the position and wait for him to turn.

source: To cancel, submit the written form at least seven days before your renewal date.
target: The written form, seven days before the renewal. Not a call, not a promise, a form. Paper outlives memory, and companies have very short memories for what they owe.

source: Would you be able to confirm whether the directions you provided lead to the north entrance or the south entrance, as the two are a kilometre apart?
target: North entrance or south. A kilometre lies between them, and your directions did not say which. Tell me now, before I walk it, because if I walk it, the next directions you give will be to my office.

source: signed up for my first 10k, race day is march 15
target: Your first ten kilometres, on the fifteenth of March. The distance will be run long before that morning, in all the ordinary ones. Race day only collects what the training has already decided.

source: Is the air bad enough today that we should skip the kids' football?
target: Look at the index, not the sky. Above three hundred, the children stay in and football waits. Below it, they play. The number decides; your guilt about cancelling does not.

source: our team runs entirely on one giant google sheet and it terrifies me
target: One sheet holds the whole team, and you are right to fear it. Everything that works is one accident away from not working. Make a copy tonight; fear is useful only when it moves your hands.

source: Could I bring my parents to the graduation dinner, or is it immediate family only?
target: Bring your parents to the graduation dinner. They paid for the degree in more ways than the fees. Two more chairs is a small thing to grant.
